step1_analysis.circuit_type: Double-Balanced Mixer with LMS Calibration Path
step1_analysis.description: A Gilbert cell double-balanced mixer with an auxiliary parallel mixer path used for gain and phase calibration in a Weaver image-reject receiver. The auxiliary path is controlled by DC voltages to inject a correction signal that compensates for mismatches.

paper_reference.title: A 2-GHz CMOS Image-Reject Receiver With LMS Calibration

Conversion Gain.description: Ratio of the IF output voltage amplitude to the RF input voltage amplitude.

paper_reported.value: N/A (Receiver gain not explicitly listed, IRR is 57 dB)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_rf = 270u * 10 * 0.48 = 1.3 mA/V. CG = 2/pi * gm_rf * Rload. With Rload = 1k, CG = 0.82 V/V = -1.7 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor and bias current. A 1k ohm load gives slightly negative gain, which is typical for passive-loaded wideband mixers without a tail current source.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the mixer from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id_total = 4 branches * 310 uA = 1.24 mA. P = 1.24 mA * 1.8 V = 2.2 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 50mW for the entire receiver. A single mixer block consuming ~2mW is reasonable for this technology and topology.

IIP3.description: Third-order input intercept point, indicating linearity.

sky130_expected.calculation: Pseudo-differential pair without tail current has higher linearity but depends on Vov. Vov = 0.48V gives good linearity.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 17 dBm for the receiver. The mixer alone should have comparable or slightly better linearity than the cascaded system.

Noise Figure.description: Signal-to-noise ratio degradation through the mixer.

sky130_expected.calculation: Active mixers typically have NF around 10-15 dB. The LNA in the receiver dominates the 5.2 dB figure.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Mixer NF is higher than the overall receiver NF because it lacks the LNA's gain preceding it.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure conversion gain and power consumption of the mixer. A 4-stage RC low-pass filter is used to extract the 190 MHz IF signal from the 2.4 GHz RF/LO feedthrough.
step3_testbench.spice:
* 2-GHz CMOS Image-Reject Receiver Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm1a=5u L_xm1a=0.5u
.param W_xm2a=5u L_xm2a=0.5u
.param W_xm3a=5u L_xm3a=0.5u
.param W_xm4a=5u L_xm4a=0.5u
.param W_xm5a=5u L_xm5a=0.5u
.param W_xm6a=5u L_xm6a=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

XM1 N_M1D VINp GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N_M2D VINn GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 VOUT1 VLOp N_M1D GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 VOUT2 VLOn N_M1D GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VOUT1 VLOn N_M2D GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 VOUT2 VLOp N_M2D GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM1A N_M1AD VINp GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1a} w={W_xm1a}
XM2A N_M2AD VINn GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2a} w={W_xm2a}
XM3A N_GC1 VLOn N_M1AD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3a} w={W_xm3a}
XM4A N_GC2 VLOp N_M1AD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4a} w={W_xm4a}
XM5A N_GC1 VLOp N_M2AD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5a} w={W_xm5a}
XM6A N_GC2 VLOn N_M2AD GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6a} w={W_xm6a}
XM7 VOUT1 VGp N_GC1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 VOUT2 VGn N_GC1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 VOUT1 VGp N_GC2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 VOUT2 VGn N_GC2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Loads
R1 VDD VOUT1 1k
R2 VDD VOUT2 1k

* Biasing and Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVGp VGp 0 DC 1.8
VVGn VGn 0 DC 1.8

* RF Inputs (2.4 GHz, 10mV peak)
VVINp VINp 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.01 2.4G 0 0)
VVINn VINn 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.01 2.4G 180 0)

* LO Inputs (2.21 GHz, 500mV peak)
VVLOp VLOp 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.5 2.21G 0 0)
VVLOn VLOn 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.5 2.21G 180 0)

* IF Filter (4-stage RC, fc = 500 MHz)
E1 VOUT_DIFF 0 vol='v(VOUT1) - v(VOUT2)'
R_flt1 VOUT_DIFF VOUT_FLT1 1k
C_flt1 VOUT_FLT1 0 0.32p
E2 VOUT_FLT1_BUF 0 VOUT_FLT1 0 1
R_flt2 VOUT_FLT1_BUF VOUT_FLT2 1k
C_flt2 VOUT_FLT2 0 0.32p
E3 VOUT_FLT2_BUF 0 VOUT_FLT2 0 1
R_flt3 VOUT_FLT2_BUF VOUT_FLT3 1k
C_flt3 VOUT_FLT3 0 0.32p
E4 VOUT_FLT3_BUF 0 VOUT_FLT3 0 1
R_flt4 VOUT_FLT3_BUF VOUT_FLT 1k
C_flt4 VOUT_FLT 0 0.32p

.control
tran 0.1n 100n

* Measure peak-to-peak of IF output (190 MHz)
meas tran vout_max max v(VOUT_FLT) from=50n to=100n
meas tran vout_min min v(VOUT_FLT) from=50n to=100n
let vout_amp = (vout_max - vout_min)/2

* Input diff amplitude is 20mV peak
let cg_linear = vout_amp / 0.02
let cg_db = 20 * log10(cg_linear)
print cg_db

* Power Consumption
meas tran pwr_avg avg i(VVDD) from=50n to=100n
let power_mw = -pwr_avg * 1.8 * 1000
print power_mw

quit
.endc
.end
